title: Biomass composition over the cell cycle (mass fractions)
caption: Submass trajectories stay at physiological E. coli proportions throughout the cycle.
interpretation: Sub-mass trajectories (protein, RNA, DNA, small molecules) hold steady physiological proportions: average dry-mass fractions protein 0.447, rRNA 0.103, tRNA 0.019, DNA 0.019, small molecules 0.406. Biomass composition is wild-type-like.
